items.title: Qwen4-Max goes live as a hosted 1M-context multimodal MoE with lower API prices; open weights promised for smaller Qwen4 models
items.summary: Alibaba released Qwen4-Max through QwenCloud, Qwen Studio and Qoder: a mixture-of-experts model with native vision and a 1M-token window, priced at $1.5 per million input and $4.5 per million output tokens. Alibaba says it beats Qwen3.8-Max with up to about 50% fewer tokens and over 60% lower cost per task in its own evaluation. Weights are not released; smaller Qwen4 models are promised as open weights later. Independent boards place it #6 in Code Arena WebDev, #14 overall on Agent Arena and 43 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, top Chinese model, behind Kimi K3.1 Pro.

doubt.pushback: Headline cost and benchmark claims are Alibaba's internal evaluation, and replies note cache creation is billed separately at $1.875 per million tokens while only cache reads are $0.075.

reception.summary: Repliers mostly ask for the open-weight 27B or Flash models; a few praise token savings and one preview tester liked 3D and web-design output, while others call it poor on price-performance or point out it is API-only.

items.title: OpenAI publishes a physicist's work with GPT-6 Astra on a candidate lattice definition of the Standard Model
items.summary: OpenAI's new science blog opens with physicist Nathaniel Craig describing how he worked with GPT-6 Astra to develop a candidate lattice definition of the Standard Model. Replies say three lattice field theorists reviewed the model's proof and that realistic lattice simulations are still needed. It is a vendor-published account of one collaboration, not an independent result.

doubt.pushback: Described as a candidate construction; commenters note it still needs outside checking and realistic lattice simulations.

reception.summary: Most repliers praise the physicist-in-the-loop framing and ask which steps the model drove versus which the physicist verified; none report reproducing it.

items.title: Hermes Agent adds a /goal command that keeps working across turns with a judge model checking progress
items.summary: A builder describes a Hermes Agent /goal command: set a goal and a judge model checks after each turn, continuing until it is met, with a default budget of 20 turns and /goal pause to stop. No link or release notes are given, so this is a description to verify.

items.title: llama.cpp server reported to support a /v1/realtime endpoint usable for speech-to-speech chat with LFM3-Omni
items.summary: A llama.cpp maintainer says the server has supported a realtime API route for a while and that it can drive speech-to-speech chat with Liquid's LFM3-Omni model. The post shows an image only and links nothing, so version and setup are not stated.
